adjudication.rationale: In `Jobs::RetrieveTopic#execute`, staff users pass `no_throttle: user.try(:staff?)` into `TopicRetriever` (new file `app/jobs/regular/retrieve_topic.rb`). In `TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?`, `@opts[:no_throttle]` returns `false` immediately, bypassing the Redis `setnx` throttle/lock (`lib/topic_retriever.rb`). That means concurrent staff-triggered retrieves for the same `embed_url` can both enter `perform_retrieve`, both see `TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: @embed_url).exists?` as false, and then both call `TopicEmbed.import_remote` -> `TopicEmbed.import`. In `TopicEmbed.import`, when `embed.blank?`, it does `TopicEmbed.create!` with a unique index on `embed_url` (`db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb`). The loser will raise `RecordNotUnique` on that unique index (no rescue shown), causing job failure and potentially leaving inconsistent side effects (at minimum an exception path).
